subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Obstinate
solution:
The correct answer is: Flexible

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Obstinate **means firmly or stubbornly adhering to one's purpose, opinion, etc.

 
 
• Example - *An **obstinate **refusal to apologize.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Flexible means capable of being readily changed.
 
 
• Example - *I became very adaptable and **flexible **with wide experience and skills. *
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Obstinate' and 'Flexible' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 1.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Firm means strong and steady or not likely to change.
 
• Willful means have done deliberately although the person doing it knows that it is wrong.
 
• Loyal means firm and not changing in your friendship with or support for a person or an organization.
